title: One-dimensional Gowers inner product
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $F$ assign a real-valued function on $F_2^n$ to each point of $F_2^1$. The Gowers inner product of $F$ equals the product of the uniform means of its two slices, indexed by the one-coordinate points $0$ and $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real-valued family indexed by $F_2^1$
